zones.what: Lifeboats hang at Deck 1 level; their bulk obstructs the view downward from Decks 1, 2, and 3, with Deck 1 having the most obstruction and Deck 3 the least, while the horizon remains visible.
zones.effect: You see boats and davits when looking down, but ocean and horizon stay clear; the view feels industrial rather than open.
zones.mattersTo: Matters greatly to anyone who wants unobstructed ocean views or dislikes the look of safety equipment; immaterial to those focused on horizon views or staying in interior cabins.

zones.what: The Lido Deck pool area, buffet, and outdoor活动 spaces sit directly above Deck 9 midship cabins.
zones.effect: Expect noise from deck chairs scraping, music, crowds, and foot traffic from early morning through late evening; the action overhead runs long hours.
zones.mattersTo: Critical for light sleepers or anyone expecting quiet mornings; irrelevant for those who are out exploring during the day and tolerate ambient resort noise.

zones.what: The Lido Deck pool and buffet area sits one deck above Deck 8 midship cabins.
zones.effect: You'll hear muffled pool activity, music, and crowd movement, though one deck of separation reduces it compared to Deck 9.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers and those sensitive to overhead noise; less of an issue for sound sleepers or those planning to be out most of the day.

zones.what: The main theatre (Liquid Lounge) sits directly below Deck 2 forward and midship sections.
zones.effect: You may hear show music, bass vibration, and audience applause during evening performances, typically ending by 11 PM.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to early sleepers or anyone turned in before the second show ends; not an issue for night owls or those attending the shows themselves.

zones.what: The main dining rooms sit two decks below Deck 6 forward and one deck below Deck 7 forward.
zones.effect: You may detect galley ventilation hum, service activity, and muffled dinner crowd noise during meal times (roughly 5-10 PM).
zones.mattersTo: Matters to those sensitive to mechanical hum or who want absolute quiet during dinner hours; minimal impact for most guests.

zones.what: Cabins in the aft sections of Decks 1 and 2 sit low and near the engine room and propulsion machinery.
zones.effect: You'll feel low-frequency vibration and hear a steady mechanical hum, most noticeable when the ship is at cruising speed.
zones.mattersTo: Significant for vibration-sensitive sleepers or anyone bothered by constant background hum; less relevant for heavy sleepers or those who find engine noise soothing.

zones.what: Forward cabins on Decks 1, 2, and 3 sit near bow thrusters, which activate during docking and maneuvering.
zones.effect: You'll hear pronounced mechanical grinding and feel vibration during port arrivals and departures, typically early morning and late afternoon.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers who want undisturbed mornings; not an issue for those already awake during port days or who sleep through mechanical noise.

zones.what: Anchor chain runs through the bow area on Decks 1, 2, and 3; it deploys and retracts during anchoring operations.
zones.effect: You'll hear loud metallic grinding and rattling during tender port arrivals, usually very early morning (6-7 AM).
zones.mattersTo: Critical for anyone who values sleeping in on port days; irrelevant for early risers or those planning to be up for port arrival anyway.

zones.what: Primary elevator banks run through the midship sections, creating both convenience and traffic.
zones.effect: You're steps from vertical transportation and central amenities, but you'll hear elevator machinery, door chimes, and hallway conversation throughout the day and evening.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to those who prioritize quiet over convenience; ideal for mobility-limited guests or those who value quick access to all decks.

zones.what: Deck 10 forward houses Cloud 9 Spa cabins with exclusive spa access and spa-themed amenities.
zones.effect: You get spa perks (thermal suite access, spa products) and a quiet forward location, but you're isolated from main elevator banks and central activities.
zones.mattersTo: Ideal for spa enthusiasts and those seeking a quieter, wellness-focused experience; less suitable for those who want to be near main dining and entertainment.
